jobs.name: 行舟短发
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the editable transparent isolated male front-hair asset. Image 2 is ONLY the project's frontal bald head proportion reference, do not put any face or skin in the output. Edit ONLY the two sideburn/temple ends of Image 1; keep its crown, middle part, fringe, overall width, canvas placement, charcoal ink color and meticulously fine matte ink hair texture closely unchanged. Current lower left/right hair ends are long pointed blades, and sit rigidly across the ears. Replace them with short, gently narrowing natural temple hair with a soft rounded feathered end at the upper ear, NOT pointed triangular blades. The short sideburn should have a slender vertical growth flow then naturally fade into a few tiny fine hair tips, no inward hooks and no thick black block. Ensure coherent temple coverage wide enough for the head, no exposed narrow scalp ledge. Frontal view straight, level, balanced sides. Smooth clean straight hair, minimal flyaways, traditional fine Chinese ink portrait rendering. Preserve original transparent open forehead/face space. Output ONLY this independent front cap, fringe and SHORT front-of-ear temple hair, nothing behind ears, no rear/nape hair, no face, eyebrows, ears, skin, ear-shaped cutout, shadow, halo, labels or background. Genuinely transparent RGBA. Preserve full uncropped asset with margin. Keep near-original geometry and canvas size 1402x1122 if possible.

jobs.name: 行舟短垂
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing independent opaque continuous REAR HAIR component on genuine transparent background.
